papers.title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
papers.desc: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a provider.

papers.title: Knowing When Not to Reuse: Conditional Experience Transfer in Autonomous LLM Post-Training
papers.desc: Large language models offer broad capabilities, but adapting them to evolving domains, tools, and requirements often entails repeated post-training.

papers.title: Puffin-World: Scaling a Unified Multimodal Model with Native 3D World States
papers.desc: We propose Puffin-World, a unified multimodal architecture that integrates physical understanding, spatial simulation, and 3D world generation and reconstruction without relying on external offline modules.

papers.title: Scal3R: Learning Efficient Multi-Relative Pose Query for Scalable Online 3D Reconstruction
papers.desc: Online 3D reconstruction models perform poorly on long videos.

papers.title: The Missing Temporal Link: Temporal Context Routing for Script-Driven Audio-Video Generation
papers.desc: Joint audio-video generation models have made substantial progress in visual quality and audio-visual synchronization.

papers.title: Beyond Retrieval: Progressive Latent Memory Evolution for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.desc: Streaming video understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process continuous visual inputs and respond to user queries under strict causality and bounded memory.

papers.title: PACE: Towards Surfacing Hidden Conflicts in User Requests
papers.desc: Personalized assistants should not only comply with user requests but also assess whether those requests are appropriate given the user's current circumstances.

papers.title: Last Translation Benchmark
papers.desc: For scientific progress, we need benchmarks that test the limits of state-of-the-art models, and evaluation methods that inform us about failure cases.

papers.title: Using Grounded Theory for Agent Behavior Analysis at Scale
papers.desc: Understanding agent behavior requires methods that scale to thousands of trajectories and surface new patterns in long, often unfamiliar tasks where pre-built classifiers fall short.

papers.title: FlashRender: Few-Step Generative Rendering via Camera-Controlled Video MeanFlow
papers.desc: We present FlashRender, a few-step generative rendering framework that retakes a source video along a target camera trajectory in seconds.

papers.title: Select, Compress, Reinvest: A Controlled Study of Visual-Token Allocation in Long-Video MLLMs
papers.desc: Long-video language models cannot look at every frame: an hour sampled once per second is 3,600 images, and a system keeps only a small fixed slice of that pool.

papers.title: Let Confidence Change, Not the Prediction: Prediction-Preserving Repair for Post-hoc Calibration
papers.desc: Post-hoc calibration corrects reported confidence, yet a multiclass calibrator can also change the associated top-1 prediction.

papers.title: QCell: Recombining and Aligning Cell Queries for Overlapping Instance Segmentation
papers.desc: Instance segmentation of overlapping cells in microscopy remains challenging due to semi-transparent structures that produce weak boundaries and mixed visual evidence in overlap regions.

papers.title: Percolation Dynamics in Optimization : Variance Cascades and Discrete Scale Invariance
papers.desc: We study the dynamics of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), which is known to steer deep neural networks toward invariant sets that correspond to simpler subnetworks.

papers.title: DRACO: Fine-Grained Credit Assignment with Dynamic Rubrics for Long-Horizon Agent Training
papers.desc: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards works well when a task has a programmatic checker, but most long-horizon agent domains have none.
